description: True net-pay comparison of travel nursing against a permanent staff post, ported from ApexLogics Apex #132 (AL-139). Stacks a caller-asserted tax-free housing stipend and M&IE allowance against contract gap weeks, per-contract travel cost and out-of-pocket housing shortfall; reports staff gross and net, staff net excluding benefits, travel taxable net, the annual delta, the counterfactual stipend tax savings at the caller tax rate, the gap-week opportunity cost, total hours worked and the effective all-in travel hourly rate, with a strict travelWins verdict. NOT TAX ADVICE: the excludability of the stipends is a caller-asserted treatment the node does not validate. The kernel reproduces the Apex page exactly, including its zero-swallow on all fourteen inputs (0 is falsy to the page, so 0 silently reverts to the page default) and its no-intermediate-rounding payload; both defects are carried as flagged behaviour, not fixed (payload DIFFERS.md D1-D8).
